s: Dine birkat yeraqot, ubo v' seipim: al hayraqot mebarek "bore peri haadama", ben chayyin ben mebushshalim, veken mine qitniyyot shettobin chayyin umebushshalim. Vaapillu mine yeraqot veqitniyyot shettobim mebushshalim yoter mechayyin, im derek rob bene adam leoklam gam ken keshehem chayyin — mebarek "bore peri haadama" gam keshehem chayyin. (Vaapillu mine yeraqot sheen derek rob bene adam leoklam chayyin ella al yede pat o dabar acher, kegon betzalim vekayyotze bahem, uba leoklam bipne atzman). Umikkol maqom, shum ubatzal shehizqinu veenam reuyim leoklam chayyin belo pat mippene shehem sorepim bimod — mebarek alehem "shehakkol" (kemo al hachometz, hoil venishtannu ligriuta). Ukeshehem mebushshalim mebarek alehem "bore peri haadama", apillu bishshelam bipne atzman. Veap al pi shedderek akilatam mebushshalim hu littenam battabshil velo leoklam bipne atzman, mikkol maqom, kevan sheggam keshehem battabshil darkam leheakel vaakilatam chashuba, ap al pi shehi tepela etzel hattabshil — hare derek akilatam zo [ma]cheshibatam lebarek alehem "bore peri haadama" belo pat. Veen domin leshebet vekammon vekayyotze bahem shekkeshehem battabshil en akilatam chashuba[h], sheenan asuyin laakila kelal, lepikak ap keshebbishshelam bipne atzman, o apillu okelam chayyim — eno mebarek alehem ella "shehakkol", kemo shennitbaer besiman r"d:

Abal shum ubatzal shello hizqinu, veken kereshim vekayyotze bahem, shehem tobim chayyim, ukeshemmebashshelim otam bipne atzman hem mitqalqelim veen taaman tob kemo chayyin — mebarekim alehem "shehakkol", kevan shennishtannu ligriuta. Vaapillu nitbashshelu im basar o dabar acher venishtabbechu, kevan sheen hashshebach mitztzad atzman — en moil lahem lebarek "bore peri haadama". Veenan domin leegoz shennitbashshel bemayim venishtanna ligriuta veachar kak tiggenuhu bidbash venitqan, shemmebarekim alayv "bore peri haetz" ap al pi sheen hattiqqun vehashshebach ella mehaddebash, kemo shennitbaer besiman r"b, lepi shehaegoz hu iqqar vehaddebash hu tapel elayv letaqqeno ulehakshiro, mah sheen ken beshum vekayyotze bo, shehattabshil shemmashbichan hu iqqar vehem meqabbelim taam mimmela:

Yesh mine yeraqot sheen derek leoklam chayyin (apillu im pat) ella mebushshalim, o meluchim o kebushim sheddinam kimbushshalim, kegon kerub delaat uteradin vekayyotze bahem — mebarek alehem keshehem chayyin "shehakkol nihya bidbaro", umebushshalim o kebushim — "bore peri haadama". Veken mine lepatot (sheqqorin ryby"n [v]mary"n) derek akilatam hu leoklam mebushshalim, umebarek alehem "bore peri haadama" keshehem mebushshalim o kebushim bechometz o bechardal. Vaapillu im hayu mishtannim ligriuta im hayu mebushshalim belo basar venishtabbechu mechamat habbasar, kevan sheddarkam bekak lebashshelam im basar kede sheyyitten taam bahem — hare derek akilatam zo machshibam lebarek alehem "bore peri haadama". Mah sheen ken beshum vekayyotze bo, sheen darkam littenam battabshil kede sheyyitten hattabshil bahem taam, ella kede sheyyittenu hem taam bo, lepikak en derek akilatam zo machshibatam yoter mechashibutam bipne atzman. Ukeshehem chayyim — mebarek alehem "shehakkol", sheen zo derek akilatam sheal daat ken noteim otan:

Veken qitniyyot yebeshim, haokelam chayyim — mebarek "shehakkol", sheen zo derek akilatam. Abal beodam retubbim — mebarek "bore peri haadama", apillu al hashsharbitin hareuyim laakila. Bammeh debarim amurim? Beshel ginnot, shehen nizraim al daat leoklan chayyim, abal hannizraim bassadot, darkam lehannicham uleheakel mebushshalim, ulepikak en mebarekim alehem keshehem chayyim, apillu beodam retubbim, ella "shehakkol", ben al haqqitniyyot ben al hashsharbitin:
Yeraqot shessechatan — mebarek al memehem "shehakkol nihya bidbaro" keal shear me perot. Abal al me bishshulam — mebarek "bore peri haadama", kemo shennitbaer besiman r"b:
Yaraq mechuttak, apillu nechtak lachatikot qetannot — lo nishtannet birkato, veal derek shennitbaer besiman r"b:
